reply.text: {"say":"Chest day with no bench in sight: dips and machine presses up front, then cable and machine flies to finish, so you can work around the crowd.","title":"Chest Day","days":[{"name":"Chest","exercises":[{"key":"parallel-bar-dip","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lean forward slightly to bias the chest.\u200b"},{"key":"machine-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the return, full stretch."},{"key":"machine-incline-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive through the upper chest."},{"key":"cable-crossover","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze hands together, pause one second."},{"key":"pec-deck-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow stretch, keep elbows soft."}]}],"unmet":[]}
